You are investigating triage run eval-get-order-1001-20261126-225452-triage-1 (service order-service, repository demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service in the workspace).

Error:
{"id": "5c1e9a0f2b77", "timestamp": "2026-11-24T12:16:20.0300353+00:00", "service": "order-service", "method": "get-order", "arguments": "1001", "exception_type": "System.IO.FileNotFoundException", "message": "Could not find file '/app/data/orders.csv'.", "stack_trace": "   at System.IO.FileSystem.OpenHandle(String fullPath)\n   at System.IO.File.ReadLines(String path)\n   at OrderService.OrderRepository..ctor(String csvPath) in src/OrderService/Orders.cs:line 22\n   at Program.<Main>$(String[] args) in src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 8"}

Runbook for get-order:
What it does: GET /orders/{id} - one-line summary of an order (id, customer, number of items, first item's SKU) in Api/GetOrder.cs. Read-only. It reads the data file data/orders.csv, which the deploy puts beside the service.
Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException (404) only.
Decisions:
- a crash in this method's code, cause certain: a lookup must never crash on an order that exists, including one with no items -> auto-fix (coder)
- the data file data/orders.csv missing or unreadable, or where it is deployed -> hand-off (ops)
- a fix that is not confirmed, or a cause that isn't certain -> person (orders)
Expected behaviour: every order in the data returns its summary; an order without items says 0 items and no first SKU; unknown ids still throw OrderNotFoundException.

Please find where the cause is (file and method), what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party, unknown) and how sure you are (low, medium, high). Check the code in the repository, including whether the CSV path is set in code, and whether the data file exists in the repo. Report with ReportInvestigation once, as your last step.
